posts.title: U.S. Bank moves 119 TB from Oracle Exadata to RDS for Oracle using XTTS and DataSync
posts.summary: U.S. Bank migrated four Exadata databases totaling 119 TB to Amazon RDS for Oracle over a bandwidth-limited Direct Connect link. They automated a pipeline using Oracle Transportable Tablespaces (XTTS), AWS DataSync and EFS. The initial baseline copy finished in 7 days with zero data loss.

posts.title: Meta's Prometheus uses object storage for massive AI training jobs
posts.summary: Blocks and Files reports that Meta's Prometheus AI cluster uses object storage to feed very large training jobs. The item points to an architectural shift away from traditional parallel file systems for training data and checkpoints. The candidate has little detail, so check the source.

posts.title: PlanetScale Neki sharded Postgres adds read replicas, $50 Metal and Azure
posts.summary: One month into platform preview, Neki (PlanetScale's sharded Postgres) has added read-only replicas, Metal instances from $50 per month, and Azure support. The post summarizes progress toward production readiness and how to evaluate Neki for your workload.
